messages.text: Is the included power supply actually reliable?

Yes — and it's genuinely one of the better "what's in the box" stories here.

**MEANWELL LRS-350-12** (12 V / 29 A, 350 W) — UL/CE/UKCA certified industrial supply.

The miner draws **~100 W at full speed**. That's roughly **30% of the PSU's cap····** — it's barely breaking a sweat. Industrial power supplies run cooler, quieter, and longer when they're not stressed near their ceiling.

Why that matters:
- **Competitors bundle ~99–124 W bricks** — a 100 W miner on a 100 W brick is running at the limit 24/7
- **This one has headroom to spare**, so it won't be the thing that dies first
- It's the **same supply that powered a 10 TH/s overclock research run** — serious overhead baked in

**Bottom line:** it's not a cheap afterthought brick. It's an oversized industrial unit rated for 24/7 continuous duty — included in the $249 price, no extra parts needed.
